data.title: Registration and abstract submission.
data.lede: Submit abstracts and complete registration through the official 4ID portal.

data.heading: Registration and abstract submission are open.
paragraphs: Use the 4ID portal to submit abstracts and complete registration for ICH2026.
Oral presentations will be selected from submitted abstracts.
Abstracts should be 250 words maximum, excluding title, authors, and affiliations.

data.heading: ICH2026 registration, November 2-4.
paragraphs: Fees are listed in Chilean pesos (CLP). USD amounts are approximate.

The ICH2026 registration fee includes the Opening Reception on November 1, lunches on November 2 and 4, coffee breaks, and the Gala Dinner on November 4. For participants attending the Andes Virus Workshop on November 5, lunch and coffee breaks are also included.
data.caption: ICH2026 registration fees

rows.category_detail: Social events only; no conference access

notice.heading: Accompanying person access
notice.body: The accompanying person fee includes only the Opening Event on the evening of November 1 and the Gala Dinner on November 4. It does not include access to the scientific programme, conference sessions, lunches, coffee breaks, or any other ICH2026 activities.

data.heading: Andes Virus Workshop, November 5.
data.label: All categories
data.description: Registration is open. Participants may attend the ANDV Workshop without registering for ICH2026, or add the workshop to their conference registration.
